svg.title: Encryption protects the envelope. A signature protects the letter.
svg.text: CAN YOU TRUST THIS CHARGING STATION?
What a roaming chain protects – and what it doesn't.
Every hop is encrypted – and every hop can open and rewrite the letter.
Platforms pass the sealed letter on. Anyone can check the seal.
OICP, OCHP, OCPI, DATEX II: every hop is secured,
but the data itself carries no seal of its author.
